ledger: magician | wearing blue suit and red tie | performing trick with cups and coins at circular table | camera pulls back from close-up to medium wide shot
cups | four red/metal cups on green felt mat | four cups arranged on table | consistent number throughout
coins on green mat | no coins on mat surface at start | three coins appear on mat around 00:03 | remain on mat

findings.description: Three gold coins spontaneously appear lying flat on the green felt mat in front of the cups during the camera pullback, despite neither of the magician's hands placing them there.
